chunks: And whatever is in it from Saʿīd ibn Yasār, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr al-Bazanṭī, from al-Mufaḍḍal, from Saʿīd ibn Yasār al-ʿAjalī al-Aʿraj al-Ḥannāṭ al-Kūfī.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Saʿid ibn Yasar in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Saʿid ibn Yasar in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting hadith transmission and identifying the chain of authorities linking the compiler to the original narrator.
